newsitem.title: USA: Western Digital confident of win in suit.
newsitem.headline: Western Digital confident of win in suit.

text.p: Western Digital Corp said it remains confident that allegations made by Amstrad Plc concerning its drives are unfounded and that it will prevail in its litigation against Amstrad.
Earlier, a London court ruled in favor of Amstrad, which had sued Seagate Technology Inc for alleged defects in hard drives Seagate had provided to the British computer manufacturer.
Amstrad also filed a lawsuit against Western Digital Corp concerning the same series of computers in California in 1991, and that litigation is still pending.
Western Digital said although both cases involve Amstrad computers in the 2000 series, the underlying facts of the cases are quite different.

It said Seagate essentially acknowledged a particular design problem with its drive, but disputed the significance of that problem. In the U.S.-based Western Digital case, Amstrad, after more than five years of litigation, has yet to identify the defect it claims affected the Western Digital drives, it said.
